veranderings.voor: Die ngoma se beesvel is oor 'n wye opening gespan en hoort aan die lae kant.
veranderings.na: Die ngoma, met sy beesvel oor 'n wye opening gespan, hoort aan die lae kant.
veranderings.rede: As written the grammatical subject of 'hoort aan die lae kant' is the skin, not the drum; the rewrite makes the ngoma the thing that sits on the low side, with no content added.
'die danser' points back to a dancer never introduced in the lesson; the indefinite article reads naturally for a general statement.

veranderings.voor: al klink hulle ewe hoog en hard
veranderings.na: al klink hulle ewe hoog en ewe hard
veranderings.rede: Without the second 'ewe' the phrase can be read as 'equally high, and loud'; repeating it makes clear both qualities are equal.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The decided definition reads ''n Groep instrumente wat saamgegroepeer word', which repeats 'groep' inside its own explanation and sounds circular to a Grade 4 reader; a person may want to look at it for the whole subject-grade. Not changed.

'Bewegings van die lyf, soos die hande, kop of arms' lists body parts after a head noun that means movements, so strictly it reads 'movements such as the hands'; a subject-wide wording like 'Bewegings van die lyf, soos van die hande, kop of arms' might be worth a person's look. Not changed.
